About Me

I'm a second-year BSc Environmental Science student at JKUAT in Nairobi. I care about cleaner cities, safer water and healthy ecosystems, and I learn best by getting out into the field. When I'm not studying, you'll find me swimming, travelling or behind the wheel. My goal is to become an environmental scientist who turns research into real change.

Fun fact: I can easily see in the dark.
